bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Spirit fought at his memorial above the gates to the City of Tears after acquiring the Dream Nail. Attacks: Ring Slam, Ring Curtain, Teleport. Drops 100 Essence on defeat.

objectives.name: Acquire the Dream Nail
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain the Dream Nail to unlock the ability to fight dream boss spirits and collect Essence

objectives.name: Fight Elder Hu at his memorial
objectives.hopDescription: Travel to Elder Hu's memorial above the gates to the City of Tears and engage his spirit using the Dream Nail
objectives.note: Requires Dream Nail; use Shade Cloak and Spell build for easier completion

objectives.name: Collect Essence from Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: After defeating Elder Hu, collect the 100 Essence he shatters into using the Dream Nail

objectives.name: Obtain the Love Key in Queen's Gardens
objectives.hopDescription: Find the large dead Husk Dandy in Queen's Gardens and collect the Love Key it holds; optionally Dream Nail the corpse for lore dialogue

connectors.description: Elder Hu traveled from Mantis Village toward the City of Tears borderlands; his memorial is above the City of Tears gates
